identity.title: [v0.92][Runtime Security] Make lifecycle TLS authority config-only

values.summary: Remove TLS argv fields, validate config-owned paths, update the Guardian-generated config, and prove the config-only lifecycle path.

steps.action: remove lifecycle TLS command flags and consume validated config fields
update Guardian config generation and regression coverage

invariants: Runtime configuration remains the sole TLS authority
TLS material and sensitive paths never enter command argv
invalid or ambiguous TLS configuration fails closed
risks: fixture configuration may diverge from production schema
path validation may regress HTTPS or WSS lifecycle startup
stop_conditions: the fix requires certificate issuance or public DNS changes
the Runtime configuration cannot represent required TLS authority
